BETTING DISCLAIMER


The following Betting Disclaimer (the “Disclaimer”) applies to your use of the website owned by Punch Nigeria Limited (“PunchNG”, “we”, or “our”) located at www.punchng.com (the “Website”) and governs your access to, and use of, any information, content, advertising materials, or educational materials related to online sports betting available on this Website (the “Online Sports Betting Content”).


Please read this Disclaimer carefully. If you do not agree to this Disclaimer, please exit the Website immediately and discontinue further use. By accessing or using the Website, you expressly acknowledge and agree to this Disclaimer.


Punch Nigeria Limited is not an online sports betting or gambling operator, and this Website does not constitute a gambling or sports betting platform. All Online Sports Betting Content available via this Website is intended solely for news, entertainment, educational, informational, and/or advertising purposes.


Accessing and utilizing the Website and any Online Sports Betting Content provided is entirely at your discretion, choice, and risk. It is your sole responsibility to ensure compliance with age restrictions and other legal and regulatory requirements before registering with any online sports betting operator referenced on this Website. Any access or use of the Website or the Online Sports Betting Content that violates local, state, federal, tribal, provincial, or national laws or regulations is strictly prohibited.


Given the variability in laws and regulations concerning online sports betting across different jurisdictions, you are strongly advised to consult applicable local laws to ascertain the legality of engaging in online sports betting activities.


Nothing contained within the Website or its Online Sports Betting Content should be interpreted as a guarantee or assurance of winning any wager or bet you undertake, nor should it be considered as inducement or encouragement to participate in sports betting activities. Please be advised that all forms of sports betting carry inherent financial risks. Should you decide to engage in sports betting, we urge you to do so responsibly, recognizing that success is not assured and acknowledging the potential to lose some or all money wagered. Punch Nigeria Limited cannot be held responsible or liable for any such losses.


The Website may contain advertising (including affiliate or referral links) for sports betting operators from whom we may receive compensation. For inquiries regarding such advertisements, please contact us at editor@punchng.com.


Although Punch Nigeria Limited endeavors to provide accurate and reliable information, we cannot guarantee the accuracy, completeness, or currency of information available on our Website. Please contact us if you encounter inaccurate or incorrect information.


Punch Nigeria Limited bears no responsibility for customer service issues related to sports betting activities or operators referenced in the Online Sports Betting Content. Please contact the relevant betting operator directly using the contact information provided by them for any inquiries or issues.


Betting can become addictive. If you or someone you know has a gambling problem, we strongly encourage seeking help immediately. For support resources, please visit:
https://www.gamblersanonymous.org/ga/addresses.


This Disclaimer shall be governed by the laws of the Federal Republic of Nigeria.

Last updated: 21 June 2023
